work_relations.note: Art historians widely see Monet's serial paintings as a precursor to the seriality in Pop Art. Warhol's repetition of a single motif explores themes of mass production, echoing Monet's study of subtle variation within a series.

places.name_display: Museum of Modern Art, New York
places.connection: The Museum of Modern Art in New York is one of the primary locations where Andy Warhol's Campbell's Soup Cans artwork is displayed.
The Ferus Gallery in Los Angeles was the first to exhibit Warhol's Campbell's Soup Cans in 1962.
